service.agent.batch.summary: Schedule a batch of tool calls. Each context.execute call retains permission checks and executes at most once.

service.agent.clear.summary: Clear the active conversation through an interceptable service.

service.agent.compact.summary: Request compaction through the shared context service.

service.agent.run.summary: Execute a prepared turn through a replaceable strategy. Return a TurnOutcome in {value}.

service.agent.tools.summary: Resolve the effective tool definitions before a turn. Only returned tools can be called.

service.auth.status.summary: Read the selected authentication implementation's status.

service.context.compact.summary: Replace conversation compaction using the public turn context.

service.context.manage.summary: Run a replaceable context-pressure strategy before a model step.

service.context.prepare.summary: Prepare user input and optional attachments without assuming repository references.

service.session.append.summary: Persist a session event through a replaceable journal implementation.

workspace.changed.summary: User-selected filesystem scope for this session. File entries grant only that file; directory entries grant descendants. Replayed on resume.

service.agent.enqueue.summary: Queue a deduplicated plugin-owned agent follow-up without waiting for a model response. Runs after the current turn, pauses after interrupt, and is revoked when the plugin unloads.

service.background.jobs.summary: Optional background-jobs plugin subscription management. Starting, reading output and cancelling shells remain guarded exec/exec_output/exec_kill operations.

shell.completed.summary: A host background shell closed. Metadata only: no command, environment or process output. Emitted once per process after output streams close.

service.shell.jobs.summary: Inspect this session’s host-owned background shells without reading command output. An optional id selects one job.

session.start.summary: Once per loaded plugin before the first prompt, and again after that plugin reloads. Carries the session composition (the udev moment: the module sees the device).

session.reload.summary: Plugin set changed. In-memory plugin state is recreated; reload is a state-recovery point.

session.compact.summary: The conversation is about to be compacted.

prompt.submit.summary: A prompt is submitted. Rewrite text/context via next(), or drop it.

prompt.compose.summary: The system prompt is being assembled. Respond with ordered sections.

skill.prompt.summary: A skill's text is expanded for the model.

tool.call.summary: A tool is about to run. Return { result } to answer it, { deny } to refuse, or pass the (rewritten) event to next().

tool.check.summary: Pre-execution decision, after tool.call and rules. Resolves to the allow/ask/deny decision.

next.summary: accept the decision reached so far

tool.describe.summary: Once per tool, when its description is first sent to the model.

description.summary: replace it; isDeferred puts the tool behind tool search

turn.step.summary: One request is about to go to the model. Async-generator hook: may yield intermediate values.

turn.complete.summary: A turn ended. May show a line under the answer.

agent.offer.summary: A subagent type is offered to the model.

agent.spawn.summary: A subagent or teammate is about to start (or resume). May pick its model or deny.

next.summary: pass on, possibly with a different model

prompt.steer.summary: A steering message is injected into the running turn (codex Tab semantics).

prompt.queued.summary: A prompt arrived while the agent was busy; it will start when the turn ends.

assistant.text.summary: One streamed assistant text delta. Renderers usually subscribe() instead; the chain event exists for plugins that log or rewrite.

tool.result.summary: A tool call resolved (ok or error). Errors are values — the turn continues.

turn.failed.summary: A turn ended in an error (model failure, stream error). Fail-operational: the session stays alive.

turn.interrupted.summary: The user interrupted the turn. In-flight model stream and tools were aborted best-effort.

turn.usage.summary: Token usage of a turn, cumulative across its model steps. Fires before turn.complete/failed so cost plugins can tally.

subagent.start.summary: A subagent (fresh AgentCore, isolated transcript) started on a prompt.

subagent.complete.summary: A subagent finished: ok with its final text, or failed with an error value (fail-operational).

context.compacted.summary: The transcript was compacted: the middle was folded into a summary, system prompt and recent tail kept verbatim.

context.compacting.summary: Before context compaction, allowing observers to save state.

context.pressure.summary: Current request context budget, model limit source and estimated occupancy.

service.model.capabilities.summary: Resolve effective context/output limits for the selected model. Replaceable by provider plugins.

service.agent.instructions.summary: Resolve replaceable base agent behavior and tool guidance before a turn.

service.agent.finish.summary: Evaluate a proposed final answer; return complete or a concrete continuation instruction.

service.ui.configure.summary: Replace this plugin's appearance contribution. Partial sections inherit defaults; null removes the contribution. User window placements remain authoritative.

service.storage.read.summary: Read JSON in the calling plugin namespace; missing values return undefined.

service.storage.write.summary: Atomically persist bounded JSON in the calling plugin namespace and selected scope.

project.changed.summary: Files or Git state changed; consumers can invalidate and refresh project indexes.

service.network.configure.summary: Configure this application network client; preserves protocol and streams, never changes global process environment.

ui.visibility.summary: Plugin surface attachment and visible viewport changed; lets producers suspend hidden animations.

ui.reaction.summary: Semantic activity signal for optional visual companions. Consumers must not change the operation being observed.

service.ui.remove.summary: Remove this plugin surface from all workspaces.

agent.activity.summary: Metadata-only activity of a background agent, for optional UI observers; excludes prompts and tool arguments.

service.ui.inputTarget.summary: Label the current input destination. Routing remains owned by the plugin.

service.ui.view.summary: Publish a semantic plugin view. Action rows receive ui.press on click; placement remains user controlled.

service.agent.tool.summary: Run a user-invoked plugin tool through the normal permission and tool hook chain, without a model request.

service.ui.surface.summary: Publish or update a plugin window with optional split/sidebar/inspector/status-bar placement hints; user rules control workspace, size and focus.

ui.render.summary: A render site is about to be drawn. Return an element tree. Writing plugin state during render is forbidden.

ui.press.summary: A Button the plugin drew was pressed.

ui.change.summary: An editable semantic plugin view field changed; never submits a model prompt.

ui.focus.summary: Focus is about to move to another pane/control.

ui.invalidate.summary: Damage tracking: the plugin marks changed regions of its pane.

service.fs.write.summary: $.fs.write(path, content): write a workspace-confined file (max 10 MB).

service.exec.run.summary: $.exec.run(cmd, args?, opts?): run a workspace-confined subprocess (default 30 s timeout).

service.auth.login.summary: $.auth.login(provider?): run the auth flow of the configured auth capability.

service.ui.ask.summary: $.ui.ask / the ask_user tool: ask the human a question (optionally with choices). Headless sessions deny (fail closed).

service.ui.questionnaire.summary: Collect an atomic questionnaire with single/multiple choices and custom text; cancel or headless operation never manufactures answers.

service.ui.notify.summary: $.ui.notify(message, level?): post a transient status message.

service.skills.load.summary: Load a skill by name from the configured registry.

service.project.query.summary: Replaceable project navigation provider: files, text, symbols, definitions and graph relations. Symbolic results include resolution metadata.

service.sandbox.run.summary: Replaceable isolated code execution. Host-supplied functions are process-local callbacks receiving (args, AbortSignal); never inferred from generated code.

service.permission.review.summary: Optional risk review only after permissions require approval. A reviewer may allow this exact call or return to manual approval; explicit denies cannot be overridden.

service.context.control.summary: Snapshot or restore conversation context. Restore is restricted to interactive controls outside model execution.

model.usage.summary: Per-request usage including auxiliary calls. Provider counts are preferred; estimated=true explicitly marks a fallback used for budgeting.

service.usage.quota.summary: Read optional provider-reported account quota; unavailable is explicit, not estimated.

context.restored.summary: Conversation restored from a checkpoint; resets replay and renderer transcript.

service.checkpoint.control.summary: List, inspect and restore turn checkpoints through a replaceable provider.

service.agent.control.summary: Manage independent persisted agents and optional Git worktrees; messages run asynchronously with separate budgets.

service.model.stream.summary: Shared streaming provider gateway for agent turns, compaction and plugin model calls. Return an AsyncIterable of provider events.

context.prepared.summary: Final user content after project context and explicit file references have been expanded.

assistant.metadata.summary: Provider reasoning continuation metadata for faithful session replay.

service.session.control.summary: List, search, name, fork, archive or resume local sessions. Resume requires an interactive host.

service.session.store.summary: Local session storage operations used by interactive session hosts.

service.shell.exec.summary: Core exec tool: run a shell command (session cwd, timeout, env). With background: true it returns immediately with a shell id and keeps running.

service.shell.execOutput.summary: Read a backgrounded shell's buffered output (BashOutput analog).

service.shell.execKill.summary: Terminate a backgrounded shell by id (KillShell analog).

service.agent.spawn.summary: Spawn a subagent: a fresh AgentCore (shared provider/permissions/plugins, isolated transcript) runs the prompt to completion and returns its final text. Core-resolved.

service.workflow.run.summary: Replaceable persistent workflow lifecycle: start, inspect, pause, resume, retry or stop. Host permissions remain in each worker.

service.todo.update.summary: Core todo tool: replace (or read) the process-scoped task list.

service.file.read.summary: Core read tool: paginated file read with truncation note.

service.file.readText.summary: Internal: raw full-text read (undo pre-image). null when missing.

service.file.write.summary: Core write tool: create or overwrite a file.

service.file.edit.summary: Core edit tool: exact (or whitespace-normalized) text replacement.
